inspector_boolean_yes.description: The true value of a boolean attribute in the inspector, as Evolution's booleanTrueOption (C2).

inspector_boolean_no.description: The false value of a boolean attribute in the inspector, as Evolution's booleanFalseOption (C2).

inspector_value_invalid_range.en: Invalid value for {name}: {raw}. Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
inspector_value_invalid_range.pt: Valor inválido para {name}: {raw}. Digite um número inteiro de {min} a {max}.
inspector_value_invalid_range.description: An inspector value outside a numeric attribute's range; {name} is the attribute's display name (C6, C150).

inspector_hint_range.description: Under a numeric inspector field: the values the attribute accepts (C6).

inspector_hint_resistance.en: Ohms. You can type k or M, such as 4.7k or 1M.
inspector_hint_resistance.pt: Ohms. Você pode digitar k ou M, como 4.7k ou 1M.
inspector_hint_resistance.description: Under the NE555 resistance field: the SI prefixes it accepts (C5).

inspector_hint_capacitance.en: Microfarads. You can type a unit, such as 10uF or 0.1mF.
inspector_hint_capacitance.pt: Microfarads. Você pode digitar uma unidade, como 10uF ou 0.1mF.
inspector_hint_capacitance.description: Under the NE555 capacitance field: the units it accepts (C5).

inspector_hint_hex_digits.en: Hexadecimal, with or without 0x, such as 0xff.
inspector_hint_hex_digits.description: Under a field stored as bare hexadecimal digits, such as DIP switch positions (C5).

inspector_presets.description: Heading at the start of the row of preset chips under a numeric inspector field, such as common bit widths; it wraps to two short lines beside the chips (C6).

soc_bus_not_connected.description: The SoC bus choice of a SoC component attached to no bus, as Evolution's SocBusNotConnected (C13).

soc_bus_option_unlabeled.description: An unlabeled SoC bus in a bus choice: its component name and location, as Evolution's getSocBusDisplayString (C13).
